title: Use of Human Perivascular Stem Cells for Bone Regeneration
protocol: Isolate perivascular stem cells from human white adipose tissue.
Create scaffolds using poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) with hydroxyapatite coating.
Mix PLGA and chloroform solutions with sucrose in a polymer/sucrose ratio of 5/95, w/w.
Cast the mixture into Teflon molds to create custom-made constructs.
Freeze-dry the scaffolds overnight.
Remove scaffolds from the Teflon mold.
Immerse scaffolds in ddH2O to dissolve sucrose.
Disinfect scaffolds by immersion in 70% ethanol for 30 min.
Rinse scaffolds with three washes of ddH2O.
Prepare a simulated body fluid (SBF) solution.
Dissolve CaCl2, MgCl2•6H2O, NaHCO3, and K2HPO4•3H2O in ddH2O sequentially.
Lower the pH of SBF solution to 6 by adding 1M hydrochloric acid.
Add Na2SO4, KCl, and NaCl to the solution.
Adjust final pH to 6.5 for apatite coating application.
Prepare Mg2+ and HCO3- free SBF by adding CaCl2 and K2HPO4•3H2O in ddH2O, then lower pH to 6.
Add KCl and NaCl to the solution and adjust final pH to 6.8.
Sterile filter all solutions through a 0.22 μm PES membrane.
Subject dried PLGA scaffolds to glow discharge argon plasma etching immediately prior to coating process.
Incubate etched scaffolds in SBF for 12 h, then change to Mg2+ and HCO3- free SBF for another 12 h at 37°C under gentle stirring.
Wash coated scaffolds with ddH2O to remove excess ions.
Lyophilize coated scaffolds prior to further studies.
Prepare a PSC suspension in PBS containing cells pre-labeled by lentiviral insertion of Firefly luciferase.
Gently drop 100 μl of the PSC suspension onto spherical PLGA-based implant immediately before implantation.
Anesthetize SCID mice with isoflurane inhalation and premedicate with buprenorphine.
Make bilateral incisions in hindlimbs for muscle pouch model implantation after Betadine preparation.
Cut pockets in the biceps femoris muscles by blunt dissection parallel to the muscle fiber long axis for each mouse.
Insert PLGA-based implant with PSCs into the pocket.
Suture the fascia overlying the muscle with 5-0 Vicryl.
Close the skin with 5-0 Vicryl in a subcuticular pattern.
Treat animals postoperatively with buprenorphine for 48 hours.
Treat animals postoperatively with TMP/SMX for 10 days.
Clip hair of SCID mice (12-14 weeks old).
Disinfect the skin of SCID mice with betadine per protocol.
Make an 8-mm skin incision along the mid-sagittal suture of the mouse calvarium.
Remove the calvarial periosteum gently by Q-tip application.
Create a 4-mm parietal bone defect using diamond-coated trephine bits in a high-speed dental drill.
Place the custom-made PLGA-based implant with engrafted PSCs into the defect site.
Suture the skin with 6-0 Vicryl.
Treat SCID mice postoperatively with buprenorphine for 48 hours.
Treat SCID mice postoperatively with TMP/SMX for 10 days.
Anesthetize athymic rats (12-14 weeks old) under isoflurane inhalation.
Scrub and prepare the femur per standard protocol with betadine.
Make a 27-30-mm longitudinal incision over the anterolateral aspect of the femur.
Expose the femoral shaft by separating the vastus lateralis and biceps femoris muscles.
Remove the periosteum overlying the femoral defect with the resected femoral segment.
Place a polyethylene plate on the anterolateral surface of the femur.
Drill six pre-drilled holes through the plate and both cortices using 0.9 mm diameter threaded Kirschner wires.
Create a 6-mm mid-diaphyseal defect with a small oscillating saw blade.
Insert PLGA based implants laden with cells into segmental defects.
Close the overlying muscle and fascia with 4-0 Vicryl absorbable sutures to secure the implant in place.
Suture the skin.
Perform radiographic assessments longitudinally using high resolution XR and μCT analysis.
Scan images for μCT analysis at a resolution of 19.73 μm (100 kV and 100 mA radiation source, using a 0.5 mm aluminum filter).
Analyze images using DataViewer, Recon, CTAn, and CTVol softwares.
Perform bioluminescence imaging using an IVIS Lumina II device.
Quantify light outputs using Living Image software.
Record total light output in photons/second/sq cm/steradian.
Conduct histological and histomorphometric analysis postmortem.
Apply routine stains including Masson's trichrome, aniline blue, pentachrome, and Picrosirius red.
Use aniline blue or pentachrome for histomorphometric analysis.
Calculate pixels per high powered field using the magic wand tool in Adobe Photoshop.
Dissect the muscle pouch along fascial planes bilaterally for minimal bleeding.
Ensure the mouse walks easily on postoperative day 1 after muscle pouch model surgery.
Prepare the calvarial defect site with care to avoid injuring the dura mater.
Soak any encountered bleeding during calvarial defect preparation with a Q-tip.
